name: Drip Irrigation Sprinkler
benefit: Irrigation systems are established to provide irrigation facilities through drip irrigation, portable sprinklers, micro sprinklers, mini sprinklers, or rain guns, as per the requirements of new plants. Under this scheme, a 45 to 55% subsidy is payable for areas ranging from 4 hectares up to a maximum of 5 hectares. An additional 25% subsidy is provided to state farmers as a top-up.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.
